messages.body_plain:
Hi Christian,

[2015-02-20 13:57] Christian Oswald wrote:
> Hello,
>
> by the installation of the rj,rj.gd package I get a compilation error.
>
> -------------------------------------------------------------------------
>
> [...]
>
> --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
> What can I do with:
>
> /usr/bin/ld: cannot find -lpcre
> /usr/bin/ld: cannot find -lbz2

This means, that it cannot find the libraries pcre and bz2. For 
compilation, the devel versions of the packages of the libraries are 
normally required. If you want to compile R packages, it make usually 
sense to install r-base-dev which AFAIK includes the mentioned libraries.

Regards,
Stephan


PS: Do you know that there are precompiled packages for Debian/Ubuntu at
http://deb.openanalytics.eu/ ?

messages.subject: RMarkdown in StatET?
messages.body_plain:
Is there any plan to extend StatET's syntax highlighting to cover RMarkdown (.Rmd) files in addition to .Rnw? Using knitr calls to compile .Rmd files to HTML is pretty straightforward (see http://stackoverflow.com/a/21114044 for example) but editing an .Rmd file in Eclipse (via plain text) is not exactly a visual treat.

If not already in the cards, can you point me to Rnw highlighting source in StatET's github repo (I don't know Eclipse plugin dev well enough to find it easily) so I can investigate doing it myself?

Thanks,
-j
